bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed, but backpacks and multi-compartment bags are prohibited. All bags will be searched, and non-clear bags may undergo additional searches.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Premier Parking is available as an amenity on a show-by-show basis. It's recommended to check availability and consider arriving early to secure parking.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in The Tabernacle's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Tabernacle does not allow outside food or drink, and there is no specific information available about food and drink options inside the venue. Drinking fountains are available for water.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by The Tabernacle, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in The Tabernacle's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at The Tabernacle. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at The Tabernacle. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
